note_keep_with_previous.description: Keep authored note definitions with at least the preceding passage tail; local source-bound pagination, without changing leading.

label_font_role.description: Source-supported face for the literal embedded query label; omitted retains existing Mincho emission.

question_gap_pt.description: Family spacing between consecutive complete reading contexts with bound embedded queries; the first context after a heading retains ordinary spacing.

passage_word_space_em.description: Optional Old reading/cloze block spacing. Examples, headings, questions and choices retain their own roles.

passage_punctuation_after_em.description: Optional Old reading/cloze block spacing. Examples, headings, questions and choices retain their own roles.

historical_source_pixels.description: Old-only canonical-image hash to an exact source-pixel presentation asset. Original image payloads remain canonical; current occurrence fingerprints, source identity, decoded pixels and display geometry are checked by the native consumer.
